```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
source(file.path(root, "scripts/setup/hazardDiana.R"))
Diana <- readDiana(root)
```

{{< include /_results/hazard.diana.qmd >}}

```{r}
#| results: asis
for (Item in Diana$layout$tables) {
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_local/tbl.hazard.diana.qmd",
    stem = paste0("diana-table-", tolower(Item$label)), labels = "rewrite",
    vars = list(Item = Item, CAP = sprintf(readLines("_captions/tbl.hazard.diana.md"), Item$label)),
    root = root
  )
}
for (Item in Diana$layout$figures) {
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_local/fig.hazard.diana.qmd",
    stem = paste0("diana-figure-", tolower(Item$label)), labels = "rewrite",
    vars = list(Item = Item, CAP = sprintf(readLines("_captions/fig.hazard.diana.md"), Item$label)),
    root = root
  )
}
```
